\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item[] \textit{Note:} Per csv, the rows; the rows that record the counts; the rows whose solve selects nothing at that layer and records $-1$ (no selection); the rows written before the counts were recorded (not recorded); and over the counted rows the largest number of equilibria at any state and period, the largest number of candidates and the total number of states at which the solver fell back. The tax rule is the selection of the technical documentation, which falls back on the tax that maximizes its integral criterion where no candidate passes the equilibrium test. No selection in the tax rule: the economic-equilibrium rows, with taxes held at the baseline path; the rows of the exact recursion under CRRA preferences with the design chosen, whose tax is selected inside the design layer and counted there; and cost calibrations that failed, France\textquotesingle{}s and the regrouped UK\textquotesingle{}s observed designs being out of the cost\textquotesingle{}s reach. The design layer is that of the exact recursion, which compares the candidate designs with the retirees\textquotesingle{} savings shares held fixed and then makes the shares consistent: its candidates are the brackets of that consistency residual, and where none closes to an equilibrium it falls back on comparing each design at its own consistent shares; no selection there are the rows with the design pinned, and the log rows of the stationary check. Not recorded: the rows of the earlier cost on the design and of the path iteration under CRRA preferences, the cross-check the exhibits do not read, written before the counts existed and not rerun at the current calibration. escExperiments.csv and escExperimentsUK.csv, which the endogenous-design exhibits read, merge the escShocks* files, whose counts are the rows above. Every counted row has one equilibrium at every state and period; the solver fell back at one state of the design layer in escShocksCRRA.csv ($\rho = 2.0$, the paper's cost, All French characteristics, design chosen, exact recursion).
\end{tablenotes}
